modelDefinition.perHitAssignment: candidate preceding shot minimizing absolute timing residual under shared hero model
modelDefinition.ambiguity: unambiguous when second-best residual minus best residual >= 0.5 tick

aggregateInterpretation.warning: A fitted finite speed is an empirical latent travel parameter, not yet a canonical weapon projectile velocity.
aggregateInterpretation.highSpeedWarning: Models near the upper search boundary indicate that 64-tick replay timing cannot cleanly distinguish very high projectile speed from effectively near-instant travel at observed soul distances.
aggregateInterpretation.attributionWarning: The assigned candidate is the shot most compatible with the shared hero timing model. It is not proven to be the exact source projectile.
aggregateInterpretation.behavioralUse: No fitted travel parameter should enter the final actionable-opportunity denominator until model quality and weapon-ready state are separately validated.
